I'm now in the process of building out the core sections of the website. The hero section, as planned, uses the video background. I'm following that with an "About" section to provide context. After that, I'm constructing a "Services" section to showcase offerings in a grid format. Finally, I'll integrate the Gemini AI text generation demo into its own section to provide interactive functionality.
